_comment: Records for shipped .wasm files that are NOT built from pqctoday-hsm and so are not in public/wasm/wasm-provenance.json (that manifest is drift-checked against the hsm repo, and adding entries with no hsm commit would fail it). Each file is pinned by full sha256: rebuilding or replacing the binary without updating this record fails `gen:sbom-versions:check`, so the SBOM cannot keep describing bytes that are no longer shipped. `commit: null` means no build commit is recorded anywhere; that is stated on the page, not guessed.

artifacts.label: PQC TPM emulator (swtpm/libtpms fork)
artifacts.note: The binary embeds no release version, and the one local pqctoday-tpm build available (sha 8ddbd860…) does not match. Build commit unknown.

artifacts.label: LMS/HSS hash-based signature module
artifacts.note: No version or origin string in the binary and no build record. Origin unknown.

artifacts.label: NIST SP 800-90B estimators
artifacts.note: Versions of the tool and its libraries come from the BUILDINFO.json shipped beside the binaries, whose own per-file sha256 values are re-checked against the files.
